summary: The D-0017 lean loader data/load_source.py replaced the superseded D-0014 publication apparatus. Local preflight verified the demo package against manifest 1.1.0, the ten SOURCE tables were recreated with full column comments, named UNIQUE/PK/FK NOT ENFORCED NORELY metadata and CHANGE_TRACKING=TRUE, the exact CSV bytes were staged and copied, and every loaded table's in-Snowflake content hash matched its manifest multiset hash. The load was then rerun end to end to prove idempotency.
